final:
config_value(text: str, key: str) -> str =
  ex config_value("a=1\nb=2", "b") == "2"
  ex config_value("a=1\nb=2", "z") == ""
  ex config_value("a=b=c", "a") == "b=c"
  ex config_value("", "a") == ""
  for line in text.split("\n")
    let parts = line.split("=")
    let k = parts.get(0) else continue
    if k == key
      var value = ""
      for i in range(1, parts.len())
        if i > 1
          value = value + "="
        value = value + parts[i]
      return value
  ""
